newsitem.title: USA: Carnival's Grand Bay in Las Vegas resort.
newsitem.headline: Carnival's Grand Bay in Las Vegas resort.

text.p: Grand Bay Hotels has agreed to develop and manage a $300 million multi-use project at Monte Lago with Transcontinental Properties Inc, Carnival Hotels and Casinos, parent company of Grand Bay, said on Thursday.

The Carnival Corp subsidiary said the project is part of the $4 billion luxury residential and golf resort community of Lake Las Vegas Resort located 17 miles from the Las Vegas Strip in Henderson, Nev.
The Grand Bay Hotels development will be located in the Mediterranean-style resort village of Monte Lago, encompassing 40-plus acres on the northwest side of the lake.

The first phase of the project will include a 200-room Grand Bay Hotel, 210 luxury condominium hotel units, 30,000 square feet of office space, a 30,000-square-foot casino and a 100,000-square-foot retail village, the company said.
The project's first phase will also contain a world-famous spa, the details of which will be announced at a later date.
The project's second phase will include a 350- to 400-room Grand Bay Resort, Carnival Hotels added.

Partners in the project include Transcontinental Corp's Transcontinental Properties as master developer; Sheldon Gordon of Gordon Group Holdings Ltd, creator of The Forum Shops at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas; and DeBartolo Entertainment Group, a privately held company specializing in the development of entertainment-based real estate projects and headed by Edward J. DeBartolo Jr, owner of the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League.
